Method of Attack: Malicious payload delivery via spam emails impersonating IRS
Malware infection allowing harvesting of sensitive info or system control
Use of compromised websites posing as IRS.gov
Malware that tracks keystrokes to steal passwords
Phone scams requesting gift card payments
Discoverer: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
Attack Vector: Spam emails with spoofed IRS email addresses
Malicious file downloads after entering 'temporary password'
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with subjects 'Automatic Income Tax Reminder' or 'Electronic Tax Return Reminder'
Malicious files disguised as refund access
Use of 'temporary password' or 'one-time password' in emails
